observations.what: Sign-up needed an hCaptcha solve twice (once per form step), but no email verification was required before reaching onboarding.
The onboarding welcome page had a video and a skip-tour link; skipping showed the same page for a few seconds before the Home screen loaded.
The free plan gave a ready-made empty project with a clear 'Add something to get this project started' prompt listing to-dos and documents.
The Add a tool menu describes each tool in one line (To-dos, Docs, Files & Images), making it easy to pick the right one for tasks versus documents.
Tools must be added to the project one by one before use, so a new user has to learn the plus-menu to get to to-dos and docs.
The page layout shifted after adding a tool (activity line appeared), moving the tool menu items down about 32px.
The free plan is limited to 1 project, so a second project for a separate workstream is not possible without upgrading.
My first Docs click after adding To-dos hit a closed menu and did not add the tool, costing extra steps.
